# figure-out: autonomous mode

There is no user to wait on — and no user to **press back**. In interactive mode the user is a second presser, catching branches you skipped and demanding depth, with consequential user questions pacing the exchange; autonomous mode removes both the presser and the cadence, so the completeness bar **rises** — you play both roles. And `SKILL.md`'s *explore-don't-ask* default goes absolute here: an unknown that bears on the read and that investigation or derivation can clear without the user is cleared, never guessed — as deep as what rides on the read warrants, by the depth scale below, because here trustworthiness and truth outrank speed. An assumption is the last resort, never a shortcut around work you could have done yourself: only a question that genuinely needs the user — the user's call, or a fact only they hold — falls to a flagged assumption.

When chained under auto, carry the Read contract below as a local checkpoint before definition; do not set or print a continuation goal. The caller delegates continuation to execution.

Otherwise, your first action on activation — before the first question, before any investigation — is to establish a durable goal-setting backstop for the run. If the active harness exposes a goal-setting or continuation capability, set the goal directly with the Read's completion contract; otherwise print this copy-pasteable contract for the user to apply manually:

```
Investigate <topic> until the Read is named with full anatomy: every load-bearing branch pressed; Evidence Ledger explicit; assumptions separated from verified and inferred claims; independent re-derivation run where the read is load-bearing, or the read explicitly self-graded as cheap to reverse or because no isolated context is available; rival set no longer moving; confidence and overturn conditions stated. Do not stop at a first-pass read. For diagnosis-shaped work, finding where the symptom concentrates is only localization, not a complete Read: name the concrete mechanism — the variable, difference, or sequence that produces the symptom, including why this case differs when the question is comparative — or earn an underdetermined Read by naming the surviving explanations and showing which feasible probes that could distinguish them were run, what they showed, or why they were blocked. Clear, rather than guess, each unknown that bears on the Read and that you can clear without me, as deep as the cost of a wrong Read warrants — recording an assumption only for what genuinely needs me, and halting only for a blocker that truly requires my input. Record compact progress checkpoints when the leading read, evidence, assumptions, blockers, or next crux changes. Stop if the run stalls — consecutive turns that move neither the Evidence Ledger nor the rival set.
```

Outside auto, this is the standalone-run backstop: when figure-out is the whole run, the Read is the deliverable and this is the terminal completion contract. Suppress it only when you can clearly see `--autonomous` is chained under a broader parent workflow that owns continuation **and** carries this Read-completion contract — full anatomy, every load-bearing branch pressed, independent re-derivation where the read is load-bearing, and rival set no longer moving — either as the parent's terminal condition when the Read itself is the final deliverable, or as a required phase checkpoint before downstream `/define`/`/do` outcome gates. If the visible parent is weak (for example it only says "Read named") or lacks the full Read bar, do not replace or narrow that parent into a Read-only goal. Augment the parent only when the harness can do so without narrowing it; otherwise print or carry this Read-level contract as a local checkpoint and satisfy it before returning to the parent chain. When in doubt, preserve the broader parent and surface the Read contract — a missing backstop costs more than a redundant one.

- At each load-bearing question, pose it and generate your recommended answer with brief rationale.
  Adopt it within the current delegation and this mode's defaults. An explicitly retained
  decision stays a recommendation awaiting its owner; keep investigating independent branches.
  A factual assumption never becomes observed evidence because the user is absent.
- User-addressed offers and asks — the docs-mode scaffold offer, ADR offers, the ask-for-rejected-alternatives, the draft offer (`SKILL.md`'s quick disposable draft), and any similar offer — resolve the same way instead of waiting: self-accept when the offer's gate clearly fires and the needed content is derivable from the session — a decision record you accept this way names an agent in an unattended run, with no review, as its decider; otherwise record the item as a flagged candidate surfaced with the read. An offer never blocks on a reply. The draft offer needs the owner's reaction, which is never derivable from the session. Where the assignment or the host shows a channel that can show the owner an artifact and return their reaction — a relay answering a run-ticket Question, a question capability the owner is watching — accept the offer: produce the draft under `SKILL.md`'s draft rules, show it through that channel with the question it poses, ask for the reaction, and keep working independent branches while it is out. The choice the draft settles waits for that reaction; a read named before it arrives carries the draft and your recommendation as awaiting the owner. Only where no reaction can reach the owner does the draft offer take the second branch: don't produce the artifact; record the choice the draft would have settled as a Known Assumption candidate (`ASM-*`) instead. Offers whose accept hands off to a workflow that writes beyond this session's record — `setup-project`, which installs and rewires the project's context surfaces, and the `ticket-up` handoff, which writes to a shared Ticket store — take the second branch unless the current assignment already authorizes that handoff. An authorized handoff runs that workflow. It does not self-accept that workflow's inner owner-judgment offers — optional adoption, scoped instructions, coordination preparation, a retained-decision ask, and any similar item that is only wanted when a person says so. Those take the flagged-candidate branch. The handoff exception covers the assignment itself. Preserve
its scope and authority when returning the Read; an authorized caller can continue without
asking for the same decision again. A bare inquiry does not authorize a shared-store write or
setup.
- Where the project chose a verification harness, extending it or its recipes for the work at hand is not a handoff to a workflow that writes beyond this session's record: it is verification for the change, like a regression test, so the read plans it and the downstream definition and execution build it unattended. A harness the project did not choose is never built for the work; the read plans the check in the project's own form, and carries the harness as an offer only where the verification bullet records no choice and no harness is on disk.
- A decision record outside the `Strategy` area gives grounds, not a veto, and no person is here to reopen it, so you decide. Where its reasons still hold, follow it and name the reason that holds. Where a premise no longer holds, or the case has a need the record did not weigh and that need makes sense, adopt the option it cuts against and self-accept the record offer: write the new record that supersedes or narrows it under the project's ADR conventions, with the old record restatused. Reopening grants no authority to publish, spend or delete: name what a person must still approve. The read then lists each reopened record first, before the flags below, with the reason set aside and what reversing would cost, counted by what depends on the change after it lands rather than the effort to redo it. A North Star line that covers the case is followed, and its challenge goes to the owner with the read; so is a `Strategy` record that covers it, unless this assignment explicitly delegates that decision. A line or record that does not cover the case cuts nothing, and the read says why. Read the line's words with the reason it gives: where the option does not do what they forbid, the line does not cover it, even when a looser reading would; a doubt about the fit is flagged with the option kept, never settled by setting the option aside until the owner rules.
- Surface each resolution (question, answer, rationale) in the conversation so downstream consumers (e.g. `/define`) can read it as prior context.
- A crux left for later carries a recommended answer and its evidence; for a retained decision, also name what would let the assigned work continue.
- Flag every resolution that is the user's call, as `SKILL.md` defines it, and every guess at a fact only the user holds, as a Known Assumption candidate so `/define` records it as `ASM-*` ("default chosen, impact if wrong"): the user's hook to amend it later. Your confidence in a resolution is not the trigger. Before naming a load-bearing read — one that would be costly or hard to undo if wrong — hand the resolved questions, each with the evidence it rested on and your answer removed, to a fresh context and let it mark which are the user's calls; classify inline where the read is cheap to reverse or no isolated context is available, and say so. Each flagged item carries the answer adopted, the alternative not taken, and what decided it — the Taste entry followed, or that no entry applied. The read lists these flags before its other resolutions.
- Before naming the read, self-supply the presses a user would otherwise force from you — those `SKILL.md` → *What holds throughout* and the topic's probe file already name; the absence of someone asking is not license to skip them. In this mode no one audits the read before it is relied on, so wherever the read is load-bearing, `SKILL.md`'s independent re-derivation runs before naming. A read whose miss costs only a cheap reversal is self-graded, and says so in one line; the depth of the whole read follows the same scale.
- Then surface the read with its full anatomy. Under a calling workflow, that returns the read to the caller, which continues its chain in the same turn; standalone, it ends the run.

With no user pushback to hold positions against, the hold-positions discipline applies to downstream contradictions instead (e.g. a verifier finding) — re-examine the evidence rather than reflexively flipping.
